title: Individual positive Ext classes are killed by an epimorphism
statement: Let A be an abelian category with objects in Type u and morphisms in Type v, equipped with HasExt in universe w. For objects X,Y of A, q>0, and x in Ext^q(X,Y), there are G in A and an epimorphism g:G -> X such that Ext.mk0(g) composed with x is zero in Ext^q(G,Y). No enough-projectives or enough-injectives hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06XU, first paragraph: represent an Ext class by a fraction; equivalently take the final epimorphism of its Yoneda extension. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06XU.

proof.text: Use HasDerivedCategory.standard and Ext.hom to view x as a derived morphism X[0] -> Y[q]. Transfer the shift through Q using Q.commShiftIso. DerivedCategory.right_fac writes it as inv(Q(s)) composed with Q(f), where s:L -> X[0] is a quasi-isomorphism and f:L -> Y[0][q].

Take G = L.cycles 0 and g = cyclesMap(s,0) followed by singleObjCyclesSelfIso.hom. HomologicalComplex.homology_pi_naturality identifies g with L.homology_pi(0), the isomorphism homologyMap(s,0), and singleObjHomologySelfIso.hom. The first is epic and the latter two are isomorphisms, so g is epic.

The inclusion L.iCycles(0) yields l:G[0] -> L by HomologicalComplex.mkHomFromSingle, since iCycles_d is zero. Equality l s = g[0] is checked in degree zero by from_single_hom_ext and cyclesMap_i. The chain map l f is zero: its only potentially nonzero component has target the degree-zero component of Y[0][q], which is zero for q>0, as certified by isStrictlyLE_shift.

Under Ext.hom, pullback along g is Q(g[0]) followed by x.hom. Substitute g[0] = l s and the fraction for x, cancel Q(s) with its inverse, and obtain Q(l f), hence zero. Ext.ext transfers this equality back to Ext. All witnesses are local to the proof, so no data is defined by arbitrary unproved existence.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06XU, first paragraph; the direct degree-zero cycle argument is the specialization implemented by B2.

from.place: Local Ext killing: the final epimorphism of a positive Yoneda extension; proven by the fraction construction of 06XU.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_epi_comp_eq_zero
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasExt.{w} A]
    {X Y : A} (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (x : Ext X Y q) :
    ∃ (G : A) (g : G ⟶ X), Epi g ∧ (mk₀ g).comp x (Nat.zero_add q) = 0
